artworks.title: Arabe veillant le corps de son ami (Arab Watching over the Body of His Friend)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows one person sitting cross-legged on the floor next to another individual laying down supine. The seated person has a muscular build, a headpiece, and minimal clothing covering the lower body. The surroundings include a clay jar against a plain wall, with a dim and textured background.

artworks.title: Dead Kabyle (Kabyle mort)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure lying motionless under a draped sheet with a candle nearby. The scene appears somber, depicting a lifeless form covered with a cloth, illuminated by a candle. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques are used extensively, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The minimalist background emphasizes the focus on the central subject and the candle.

artworks.title: Il corpo di Luciano Manara visitato dai soldari (The Body of Luciano Manara Visited by Soldiers)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is an interior scene featuring a draped body on a bier. The setting includes plain walls, a closed door in the background, and a cross hanging on the wall to the left. The body is covered with a sheet on a table-like structure. Objects in the room include bottles on the floor. Figures stand to the right, observing the body. The text "ROMA - 1849" is inscribed at the top, and "IL CORPO DI LUCIANO MANARA VISITATO DAI SOLDATI" is written at the bottom. The composition shows fine lines depicting textures and shadows, typical of etching.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Great Tree
artworks.medium: etching printed in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, gnarled tree at the center. The horizon is low, with dense foliage in the background. The tree has a textured trunk and the scene is detailed with sketch-like lines and cross-hatching. The color scheme is mostly gray and black, typical of etching. Near the tree, there is uneven terrain and a reclining figure. The sky is light gray with subtle clouds.

artworks.title: The Child and the Bulldog
artworks.creditLine: Jeffrey E. Horvitz Fund and Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man, a woman, and a child, all depicted in full-body view. The man is reaching towards a small dog, the woman is standing to the right supporting the child, who is sitting on the dog. The child appears amused and curious. The background includes a wall with vertical lines and a partially visible window with sunlight coming through. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing shading and linework.

artworks.title: Study for the Theater Program for "Boubouroche" and "Valet de coeur (Jack of Hearts)"
artworks.dimensions:
image: 23.5 × 32 cm (9 1/4 × 12 5/8 in.) (irregular)
sheet: 30 × 35 cm (11 13/16 × 13 3/4 in.) (irregular)
artworks.creditLine: Given in Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a canal scene. It shows a canal with a narrowboat floating along the water. On the left side, two figures are standing on the yellow ground. The image has soft pastel tones blending seamlessly, creating depth and movement. The drawing is framed by a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on an ornate settee. He has a mustache, neat hair, and is wearing a black suit with a white shirt and a dark bow tie. He is holding a document in his right hand. Beside him is a table with a patterned cloth. The background is plain and the scene is framed in gold, resembling a historical photograph such as a daguerreotype.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on textured wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a pastoral scene with mythological elements. It shows a group of reclining figures in the foreground, surrounded by a dense landscape with foliage and architectural elements like a barrel and a stone structure. A statue of a draped, vine-covered figure stands to the left. Detailed cross-hatching and line work create depth and texture. The landscape includes a sky with swirling clouds, and the arrangement of figures suggests a narrative or allegorical theme, possibly related to Bacchus or a similar mythological subject.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting against a tree in a relaxed position. He has long wavy hair, closed eyes, and a relaxed mouth. The man appears unclothed with some foliage partially covering him. The setting is a lush environment with various plants, trees, and a rugged landscape in the background. An arrow is stuck in his side, with no visible jewelry or objects on him.

artworks.title: At Bedford Springs
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund and the Randi and Bob Fisher Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing through the center. The horizon is a densely wooded hillside. The photograph has a sepia tone. Two rustic log cabin-style buildings are near the riverbank. Trees cast shadows on the ground. The color palette includes shades of brown and muted greens. In the distance, the wooded hillside continues.

artworks.title: Porch of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an old stone building with intricate architectural details. The image shows a section of the historic structure with robust stone masonry. The walls are made of large, roughly-hewn stones, and the facade includes various architectural elements like arched doorways and windows with latticework. The structure features columns supporting part of the building, along with carved moldings and stripes around a large arched entrance. A small dome is visible above one section of the building. The stone's texture suggests weathering and age, giving the structure a historical look. Light and shadow play on the stone surface, enhancing the image.

artworks.title: Western Wall and Omar Mosque, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays a historic cityscape with an elevated viewpoint, possibly from a rooftop or higher vantage point. The horizon is seen at the upper part of the composition, showing a transition from the urban environment to rolling hills in the distance. The skyline on the horizon has variations in elevation with a large domed structure at the center and a smaller minaret to its left. The image features a monochromatic palette emphasizing stone and earthy tones of the historic buildings. The urban area near the viewer is filled with stone buildings and ruins, some of which are partially collapsed. Towards the distant hills, there are scattered trees leading to the central dome and surrounding historical architecture.

artworks.title: Pool of Bethesda, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone-built cityscape from a bird's-eye view. The horizon is positioned high in the frame, displaying weathered stone structures, some with domed roofs. A tall bell tower rises above the buildings, providing a vertical focal point. The stone walls have a rough texture, suggesting a historical setting, with a muted palette of grays and browns. A path leads through a rugged landscape towards the densely packed city architecture. The scene conveys a sense of timelessness and historical depth with monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a historic architectural structure. The image shows a detailed view of an ancient stone building, featuring a prominent dome on the upper level and two arched windows below it. The facade is constructed with neatly arranged stone blocks, and intricate stonework decorates the arched doorways and windows. The central archway features decorative carvings with a pointed appearance. On the right side, a smaller dome can be observed, and there are metal latticework elements inscribed into some of the openings. The structure showcases a mix of geometric precision and ornamental design, indicative of historical architectural styles.

artworks.title: The Golden Gate, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a large, ancient stone wall with architectural elements and a gate. The horizon is not visible due to the focus on the wall. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige. Close to the viewer, there are scattered stones and remnants of structures. Two figures stand by the wall. In the distance, the wall continues, receding into the backdrop with a subtle gradient in shading.

artworks.title: Tower of David, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a stone fortress or castle with rectangular towers and walls. The stone is weathered and aged. The buildings are closely spaced, suggesting a defensive complex. Closest to the viewer are smaller stone walls implying remnants of the main structure. The color palette is mainly earthy tones of beige and brown, highlighted by lighting that accentuates the rough surfaces and shadows. The scene has a chiaroscuro effect, emphasizing the architecture's strength and historical character.

artworks.title: Damascus Gate, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a fortified stone structure with a prominent arched gate. The building's crenellated walls have decorative elements and visible spires. The stone surface displays rough textures and smooth areas, indicating its age. The color palette is sepia-toned. A dirt path leads to the entrance with people walking on it. In the distance, a dome is visible to the right.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins in a rocky and grassy terrain. Stone fragments and blocks are scattered on the ground, leading towards larger stone structures in the middle distance. Some blocks are upright while others are tumbled. Barren hills rise in the background, blending into a hazy sky. The horizon aligns with the hilltops. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving an aged look. The stonework and landscape details are clear and well-defined.

artworks.title: Olive Trees at Gethsemane, Jerusalem
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows ancient, thick-trunked olive trees clustered together in a garden setting. The trees are gnarled and timeworn, with dense foliage casting shadows. Beyond the trees, there is sparse shrubbery, small hedges, and a hillside with a long stone wall with fortifications and battlements. The scene has a sepia tone color palette, highlighting the textures of trees, earth, and stone structures.

artworks.title: Temple of Athena Nike, Athens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: An elevated view of an ancient temple structure with four columns on one side is shown. The columns have Greek Ionic capitals with spiral scrolls at the top. The temple is made of large stone blocks, the roof appears weathered with remnants of sculptural decoration. The horizon is high in the image, leaving a pale skyline behind the temple. The image is rendered in a monochrome sepia tone, emphasizing the texture of the stones and columns.

artworks.title: Caryatid Porch of the Erechtheum, Athens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin from an elevated perspective, displaying architectural details clearly. The horizon is not distinct due to the focus on the ruins. The landscape appears hazy in the distance with soft sepia tones. The historical structure has draped female figures as pillars, with a ladder leaning against it. The weathered stone surfaces create depth, and the sepia color palette gives an antique ambiance. Stones and ruins fragments are scattered nearby, adding to the sense of ancient history.

artworks.title: Nike Adjusting Her Sandal, Temple of Athena Nike, Athens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a reclining female figure with flowing drapery, delicately carved to suggest the folds and contours of the fabric. The figure has a serene expression on her face and curled hair, with her head slightly tilted. She is portrayed as partially draped, exposing one shoulder and part of her chest. The sculpture is carved in a light-colored stone or marble, giving it a smooth and polished appearance. The composition suggests that the figure is reclining, creating a sense of relaxed grace. The backdrop of the sculpture is flat, providing a contrast to the intricate details of the figure's attire and pose.
